script.speaker: brooke
script.text: cold's officially gone and i'm back!! also i have news, and it's not mine

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: MINA SOLD A PAINTING. at the boardwalk art fair. to a total stranger!!

script.speaker: mina
script.text: it was the little one of the harbour at dusk :) a lady stood in front of it for ages, and then she just... bought it

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: MINA!! hanging on a stranger's wall forever. iconic

script.speaker: liam
script.text: so proud of you. also starving. both feelings very strong right now

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: so obviously we're celebrating today. poll's closed: little bamboo baskets of dumplings, by a landslide

script.speaker: liam
script.text: i voted four times. no regrets

script.speaker: maya
script.text: that's fraud, liam. ...i voted twice

script.speaker: mina
script.text: i walked past a dumpling place on my way home from the fair and peeked at the menu. every single one had pork or prawns tucked inside. somewhere with a whole row of vegetable ones would make my day

script.speaker: maya
script.text: mina, how much did she pay. tell me it was a lot

script.speaker: mina
script.text: enough for new paints and a frame for the next one :) maya, how's the packing? is the giant hat coming?

script.speaker: maya
script.text: the hat has its own bag. and don't ask me the date, saying it out loud makes me panic-pack

script.speaker: maya
script.text: trip fund's retired, by the way. mission complete. so i've moved up from the bottom-shelf places to the middle shelf. the top shelf is still for people with yachts

script.speaker: liam
script.text: i don't have a yacht but i do have a very big appetite. does that count

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: same!! i'm down for every basket on the table. well, except anything milky or creamy. my stomach and i signed a peace treaty, twelve days strong

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: roxy kept a rule for twelve whole days?? this summer is full of miracles

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: speaking of stomachs, mine's still a bit delicate after the cold, so today i want gentle food. steamed and light, nothing that sits in me like a brick

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: glad you're back though. your voice notes this week were pure frog

script.speaker: liam
script.text: you were stuck in bed, i was stuck counting boxes in a stockroom with no windows. table outside today, under actual sky. please

script.speaker: maya
script.text: that explains the basement-mushroom glow in every photo you sent this week

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: ok, back to our artist. we are not toasting her in a whisper. i want bustle and clatter, somewhere busy enough that our cheering blends right in

script.speaker: mina
script.text: please nobody cheer. i'll go pink

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: too late. i'm making a sign

script.speaker: liam
script.text: assistant, roxy's on the sign and i'm on the appetite. you're on everything else
